blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. Trade means buying and selling goods between people, companies or countries.

At Czarnikow, we trade sugar around the world. Sugar is our main product. We are a global team.

Today you learn 5 important words of trade. We start slow. It is easy. You can do it!

items.q: What does "trade" mean in the text?
items.why: "Trade means buying and selling goods between people, companies or countries."

items.q: What does Czarnikow trade around the world?
items.why: "At Czarnikow, we trade sugar around the world."

items.q: How many important words will you learn today?
items.why: "Today you learn 5 important words of trade."

items.q: The text says "We start slow." This suggests that…
options: there is no time to learn
the lesson is calm and easy to follow
you must already be an expert
items.why: Inferência: "We start slow… It is easy. You can do it!" — o tom é tranquilo e encorajador.

items.q: The phrase "You can do it!" shows that the author wants to…
items.why: Inferência: é uma frase de incentivo — o autor quer motivar o aluno.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Ethan dando as boas-vindas a um novo trader. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! Welcome to Czarnikow. My name is Ethan. I am a trader here. You are the new junior trader on the desk. It is good to have you here.

Let me explain. Trade is simple. We buy and we sell. We buy sugar, and we sell sugar. The people who buy and sell meet in the market. The market is open today.

Every day we look at the price. Prices are important. When the price is good, we make a deal. A deal is an agreement. Today the price is stable, and one deal is almost ready.

The goods are the sugar. Right now, our goods are on a ship. The ship is on the sea. Our team is global. We are in many countries.

Do not worry. We start slow. Your job is important, and you can do it. I am here to help you. Let us begin!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Who is Ethan?
items.why: "My name is Ethan. I am a trader here."

items.q: Where are the goods (the sugar) right now?
items.why: "Right now, our goods are on a ship."

items.q: What does Ethan say about the price today?
items.why: "Today the price is stable, and one deal is almost ready."

items.q: Ethan says "Do not worry. We start slow." This suggests that…
options: the new trader may feel nervous
items.why: Inferência: Ethan tranquiliza o novato — sinal de que ele pode estar nervoso no primeiro dia.

items.q: "Our team is global. We are in many countries." This tells us that Czarnikow…
options: works in different parts of the world
sells only in the market next door
items.why: Inferência: "global" e "in many countries" mostram que a empresa atua no mundo todo.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We trade sugar with many countries." To trade means to…
items.why: Trade = comércio/negociação: comprar e vender.

items.q: "The goods are on the ship." Goods are…
items.why: Goods = mercadorias / bens.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Buyers and sellers meet in the ___."
items.why: Market = mercado: o lugar onde compradores e vendedores se encontram.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Today the sugar ___ is stable."
items.why: Price = preço: o valor do açúcar.

items.q: "The deal is ready." A deal is…
items.why: Deal = acordo / negócio.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho de trade. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The boss must sign off on the deal." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval.

items.q: "We will roll out the new price next week." To roll out means to…
options: start it / put it in use
items.why: Roll out = lançar, colocar em uso.

items.q: "Let's close the deal today." To close a deal means to…
items.why: Close a deal = fechar o negócio, concluir o acordo.

items.q: "Can you set up a meeting with the buyer?" To set up means to…
items.why: Set up = organizar, marcar.

items.q: "The team will follow up with the client tomorrow." To follow up means to…
items.why: Follow up = dar continuidade, retomar o contato.
